title: Efficiency and defense research
items: New Efficiency vs net points per success chart: how often an offense's snaps succeed against the net expected points each success produces, with one labelled team per quadrant and a Reading the chart panel.
New Defense against a real zero: the best and worst eight defenses by expected points allowed per play, diverging from zero on one scale, with each defense's stop rate.
Matchday in public adds an Against the market record.
Group of Five teams now show as rings rather than a second shade of grey on every scatter chart, and the hover card names each chart's own measures.
